-- openrowset Extended

SELECT COUNTRY, ROUND(SUM(REVENUE_USD), 2) AS TOTAL_REVENUE
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK'https://hemanthadlsgen2.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse-container/apple_global_sales_dataset.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
    PARSER_VERSION ='2.0'
) AS [RESULT]
GROUP BY COUNTRY
ORDER BY COUNTRY ASC;


CREATE VIEW APPLE_REVENUE AS
SELECT COUNTRY, ROUND(SUM(REVENUE_USD), 2) AS TOTAL_REVENUE
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK'https://hemanthadlsgen2.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse-container/apple_global_sales_dataset.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
    PARSER_VERSION ='2.0'
) AS [RESULT]
GROUP BY COUNTRY;

SELECT * FROM APPLE_REVENUE

CREATE VIEW APPLE_REVENUE_TOP_10 AS
WITH TOP_RANKED AS(
SELECT COUNTRY, 
ROUND(SUM(REVENUE_USD), 2) AS TOTAL_REVENUE,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(REVENUE_USD) DESC) AS RN
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK'https://hemanthadlsgen2.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse-container/apple_global_sales_dataset.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
    PARSER_VERSION ='2.0'
) AS [RESULT]
GROUP BY COUNTRY
)
SELECT
COUNTRY,
TOTAL_REVENUE
FROM TOP_RANKED
WHERE RN < 11;

SELECT * FROM APPLE_REVENUE_TOP_10



CREATE VIEW PLAYERS_CLUBS AS
SELECT
PLAYER.PLAYER_ID,
PLAYER.[NAME] AS PLAYER_NAME,
PLAYER.country_of_birth,
PLAYER.country_of_citizenship,
CLUB.*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK'https://hemanthadlsgen2.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse-container/players.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
    PARSER_VERSION ='2.0'
)AS PLAYER
INNER JOIN OPENROWSET(
    BULK'https://hemanthadlsgen2.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse-container/clubs.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
    PARSER_VERSION ='2.0'
)AS CLUB
ON PLAYER.current_club_id = CLUB.club_id

SELECT * FROM PLAYERS_CLUBS;
